{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured black silk blouse with a pointed collar, boxy relaxed fit hitting mid-thigh, #1e1f22, woven twill.
Tailored charcoal wool trousers with a high waist and straight leg, cropped just above the ankle, #2c2d35, heavy wool blend.
Black leather ankle boots with a 6cm stiletto heel, pointed toe, #0a0b0e, smooth calfskin.
Thin gold chain necklace with a small geometric pendant, #f4eeb1, solid 18k gold.

This outfit respects her request for a restrained and classic look while perfectly matching the "smart" formality level required for a club event on a Friday evening. The structured black and charcoal tones provide a cool, composed contrast to the artificial rock-concert lighting without blending into the background crowd. The cropped trousers offer ease of movement for standing in the masses, while the sleek silhouette ensures she remains elegant despite the energetic atmosphere."}
